requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments online at their convenience.
Automatic reminders should be sent out 24 hours and 1 hour before appointments to reduce no-shows.
Barbers should be able to manage their schedules individually, setting hours and marking time off.
The system should provide an overview of bookings, cancellations, no-shows, and peak times.
Customers should be able to select from different services when booking.
Customers should have the option to choose their preferred barber.
Real-time availability of each barber should be displayed during booking.
The system should have a user-friendly interface that works well on mobile devices.
Customers should be able to create accounts to save personal details and preferences.
Barbers should be able to log in to their own section of the system.
A feature should allow barbers to view upcoming appointments at a glance.
The system should provide visual representations of metrics, such as graphs or charts.
Budget constraints should be considered in the design and implementation of the system.
The system should be easy to implement and maintain for a small independent business.
The interface must be user-friendly for both customers and staff to minimize training requirements.
The system should comply with data protection regulations when handling customer data.
